piece/alice-greenhouse.prompt: Compose an original solo piano piece, instrumental only (no vocals, no lyrics, no other instruments). Setting: a glass greenhouse late at night after closing time, white roses, moonlight through the glass; a shy young woman plays for one listener. Quiet and intimate: soft touch with the sustain pedal, close-miked upright/grand piano with a little natural room reverb. Slow, about 66 BPM with gentle rubato. A simple, tender singing melody in the right hand over flowing broken-chord arpeggios in the left, in A-flat major with a touch of melancholy in the middle section, then returning to the opening theme. About 90 seconds long, ending naturally and softly on a held final chord that rings out. Entirely original composition; do not quote, reference or imitate any existing piece, composer or artist.
piece/alice-greenhouse.cut: from the first note (-50 dBFS, less 20 ms) to the last above -60 dBFS, 1.5 s squared fade; not looped

piece/unpai-earphones.prompt: Compose an original lo-fi chillhop instrumental, as if heard through one shared earbud on a late-night walk through quiet city streets. Warm, dusty, slightly swung boom-bap drums played softly, mellow Rhodes electric piano seventh chords, a round warm bass, soft vinyl crackle and tape hiss, gentle low-pass warmth. A faint, soft wordless female humming ("mm", "ooh") appears now and then in the background, with no words and no lyrics at all. Relaxed, around 78 BPM, gentle, cozy and a little wistful. A steady groove from the start to the end: no long intro, no build-up, no big ending. Entirely original; no lyrics, do not quote, reference or imitate any existing song or artist.

bgm/home-evening.prompt: Compose an original instrumental background track (no vocals, no lyrics) for a warm evening at home: coming home to someone who has made coffee, golden light by the window. Soft fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar, warm felt piano, light brushed snare and soft upright bass, a little glockenspiel sparkle. Gentle, homely and cozy, around 84 BPM, F major. Keep the arrangement steady and even throughout so it can play as a seamless loop under dialogue: no intro build-up, no dramatic changes, no ending or fade-out. Entirely original composition; do not quote, reference or imitate any existing song, composer or artist.

Keep the texture steady and even from the first second to the last so it can be looped seamlessly: no intro build-up, no climax, no fade-out or ending. ambience/rain.prompt: Create a purely environmental field-recording style soundscape, with no music at all (no instruments, no melody, no rhythm, no vocals): steady gentle rain at night heard from inside a cozy room, raindrops tapping on a window pane, soft rain wash on the roof, occasional drip from the eaves.
